products.title: Wireless Predictive Thermometer with WiFi Booster
products.body_html:
More than a thermometer: it’s a secret weapon for confident cooking.

Know when it’s safe to savor with the professional-grade Wireless Predictive Thermometer and WiFi Booster. Experience total heat monitoring with industry-leading technology powered by Combustion Inc. Upgrade your meat thermometer with a complete view inside your food while it’s cooking.

Total Temperature Awareness: Eight precision sensors instantly track core, surface, and ambient air temperature. Featuring an element proof hermetic brazed seal, this thin probe thermometer reaches the highest level of heat-resistant protection at IP69K and includes 24 hours of instant read battery life.

Take the heat: Expand your grilling experience and perfect every technique with a thermometer built to withstand temperatures up to 900°F. Industry-leading technology locates the slowest-heating point for perfection–every time.

Never Speculate Again: Combustion Inc.’s signature Prediction Engine™ algorithm uses real heat transfer physics for USDA-approved cook times.

Stay in the loop and in the moment: Watch your cook from anywhere – unlimited connectivity with WiFi Boosters and WiFi Displays. The Booster also relays Bluetooth signals to other Combustion devices or to the Combustion app within range (330ft/100m).

products.title: WiFi Display
products.body_html:
Set it, and then forget it. Make way for more memories with a display that times, alerts, tracks, and lets you set your target temperature, so you can stay in the moment and be informed.  

Make Your System: Built-in WiFi connects to up to 4 instant-read predictive thermometers (not included) at once to display core, surface, and ambient air temperatures for the most accurate read possible, across multiple dishes or Eggs. 

Charged Up and Ready to Go: An extended battery life ensures your display lasts for weeks at a time, so you can spend more time cooking and less time looking.  

Safety Worth Savoring: This easy-to-use WiFi Display shows alerts, timers, and tracks temperatures for USDA-approved cook times, making food prep simpler than ever.  

Plus: the Bluetooth range extender lets you track temps anywhere–no devices or apps required.

products.title: Instant Read Digital Food Thermometer
products.body_html:

This sleek device measures from -40°F to 572°F (-40°C to 300°C), ensuring optimal doneness for every dish. The foldaway stainless steel probe and auto on/off feature combine convenience with durability, while the included storage case protects your investment between uses.

  • High-precision temperature range: -40°F to 572°F (-40°C to 300°C)
  • Compact size: 6.25 in x 1.5 in (16 cm x 4 cm)
  • Features: Auto on/off, °F/°C switch, foldaway probe
  • Includes: Storage case, ideal food temperature chart

This thermometer seamlessly integrates with your egg system, enhancing your ability to grill, smoke, roast, and bake with confidence. By providing instant, accurate readings, it empowers you to achieve restaurant-quality results in your own backyard. The included chart of ideal food temperatures serves as your personal culinary guide, ensuring each dish reaches its full flavor potential.
